summary: The quantile fix itself is correct and resolves the issue, but the diff also silently modifies sortby, which has no `keep_attrs` parameter in its signature — referencing `keep_attrs` there raises NameError on every sortby call. That is an unrelated, broken change that would break existing behavior.

issues.description: The sortby edit references a `keep_attrs` name that is not a parameter of DataArray.sortby (its signature is `sortby(self, variables, ascending=True)`). Any call to sortby now hits `if keep_attrs:` on an undefined name -> NameError, breaking previously working, untested behavior.

Scope creep: the issue is strictly about quantile honoring keep_attrs, but the patch also modifies sortby (which the bug report never mentions and which does not even expose keep_attrs). This unrelated edit is what introduces the regression above.

In quantile, keep_attrs is already forwarded to ds.quantile(...) and then attrs are re-applied on the DataArray wrapper; the manual re-assignment is a defensible belt-and-suspenders but slightly redundant/fragile if the underlying Dataset path is later fixed.
